title: Building a Fifth Element style flying taxi endless runner you can play in your browser. Appropriately called Bada Boom Taxi!
author: timcorin
selftext:
Made this with AI tools primarily Claude Code and a bit of love from Astra for art. Behold! Bada Boom Taxi, a flying cab chase through a vertical city, very much obviously inspired by the taxi chase scene in The Fifth Element.

Weave between lanes of flying traffic, dive between towers, keep ahead of the cops. Runs free in the browser on phone or desktop, with a daily leader board on one seeded city a day. Im loosely basing it on 'squares' if we remember that, with emphasis on music manipulation for vibes. 

It's early development, so tell me what's broken or what you'd add. Hope you get a laugh out of it!

[https://badaboomtaxi.io](https://badaboomtaxi.io)
